eyebrow: A considered space for your career
intro: Coffee Chat Note is your private notebook for professional conversations, meaningful connections and the next step in your career.
localBody: No app account required. Notes, contacts and photos are stored locally. You choose when and where to export them.
settingsBody: Open Home → Settings to choose one of 12 languages and System, Light or Dark appearance. These preferences are free and saved on your device.
proBody: Pro adds templates, collections, contact cadences, workflows, reports, an opportunity board, a knowledge library, statistics, custom exports, relationship maps and themes. Monthly and yearly subscriptions include the same tools.
faq: A little help, when you need it.
backupQ: How do I back up or move my notebook?
backupA: Open Settings → Backup and Restore to export a complete JSON backup, including records, relationships and photos. Save it in a trusted place. To move devices, transfer that file and import it on the new device. Preview the restore choices carefully; exports may contain private information.
reminderQ: Why did a reminder not appear?
reminderA: Check notification permission in iOS Settings, enable the reminder on the pending task, and check its date and pause setting. Date-only reminders occur at 9:00 AM in the task’s selected time zone. The nearest 60 future reminders are scheduled and refreshed when you open or edit the app. Focus modes and system notification settings can affect delivery.
restoreA: Use the same Apple Account used for the purchase, then open Settings → Pro → Restore Purchases. An active subscription is required. Connect to the App Store if the status cannot be verified. Backup files do not transfer Pro access.
cancelQ: How do I cancel, and what happens to my notes?
cancelA: Manage or cancel in iPhone Settings → your name → Subscriptions. Canceling stops the next renewal; Pro stays available until the paid period ends. Free notes, existing template answers, and complete backup and restore remain available afterward. Apple handles refund requests.
helpTitle: Let’s get you back to your notebook.
helpBody: Email the app version, iOS version and steps that reproduce the issue. Include a screenshot only if helpful, and remove names, notes and other private details first. Please do not send a full notebook backup unless you decide it is necessary.
privacyIntro: Privacy policy for Coffee Chat Note, provided by Yung Wen Cheng. Effective October 9, 2026.
p1Body: The app stores the contacts, organizations, conversations, notes, photos, opportunities, tasks and preferences you enter in a local database on your device. The developer does not receive this notebook content. No app account or developer-operated cloud sync service is provided.
p2Body: The app contains no advertising, third-party analytics, tracking SDK or AI service. It does not send your notebook content to the developer. It does not request access to your system address book or precise location.
p3Body: Apple handles purchases, payment and subscription verification through StoreKit under Apple’s policies. The app reads entitlement information to enable Pro; the developer does not receive your payment card details. Optional notifications are scheduled locally. Privacy Lock uses Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode through the system; the app cannot access biometric templates or your passcode. Selecting a photo gives the app only the photo you choose.
p4Body: You control exporting, saving and sharing. Exported files may contain private notes, contact details and photos; the destination service then follows its own policies. Device or iCloud backups may include app data depending on your Apple settings. The app has no separate developer cloud backup. Deleting an in-app record does not delete copies you previously exported or shared.
p5Body: You can edit or delete records in the app and export a complete backup. Removing the app removes its local data from that installation; separately stored exports and system backups must be managed in their respective locations. Privacy Lock limits app access but is not a separate encryption layer for the database or exported files.
p6Body: If you email support, your email address, message and attachments are received to answer your request. Send only what is needed. You may ask us to delete that correspondence, subject to necessary legal retention. This support website is hosted on GitHub Pages, which may process technical request information under GitHub’s privacy statement. The site uses no advertising or analytics cookies. Your language choice may be saved locally in your browser.
p7Body: Material changes to app data practices will be reflected in this policy and the App Store privacy information. For privacy questions, contact the support email below.
legalIntro: Terms of use for Coffee Chat Note. Effective October 9, 2026.
t1Body: Use of the app is governed by Apple’s Standard End User License Agreement (EULA). The information below explains the app’s subscription and support arrangements and does not replace your statutory rights.
t2Body: Pro is optional and offered as an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Both plans provide the same Pro tools. The price, currency and billing period shown in the App Store purchase confirmation apply. Payment is charged to your Apple Account after confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel through Apple at any time.
t3Body: Cancellation stops future renewal and does not immediately end a paid period. After access expires, new use of Pro tools requires an active subscription. Your existing notes, existing template answers, and complete backup and restore remain available. Restore Purchases uses your Apple Account and requires a valid entitlement. Apple manages refunds under its policies and applicable law.
t4Body: You keep ownership of your content. Respect the privacy and rights of the people whose details you record. Keep backups of important information and protect exported files. The app helps organize your own career research; it does not guarantee introductions, employment or other outcomes.
